tools.name: check_stackless_connection
tools.description: Check Stackless API auth with the configured Bearer token or ALB cookies.

tools.name: get_stackless_operation
tools.description:
Get operation status with a compact preview or publish result by default.

Preview summaries include dbt counts/failing nodes and up to three sample rows.
Request details with include: sample_rows, compiled_sql, logs, generated_files.
Each detail is returned once, with truncated_fields naming any cuts. Logs omit
the project-parse preamble and retain the tail and outcome lines. Read the model
spec with get_transformation_model; operation results never echo it.

tools.name: get_stackless_invocation
tools.description: Recover MCP invocation status from a tool_name and idempotency_key.

instructions: Before editing an existing dashboard, call get_stackless_dashboard for its compact summary and permission-aware workflow. Fetch only the widgets you need; use view='full' to read a complete replacement spec. Use check_stackless_connection to inspect effective access; instructions do not grant permissions or replace explicit publish approval.
